description: This file defines a trait and associated objects/classes for a collection of key-value pairs partitioned by an integer partition ID, supporting sorted iteration and writing capabilities within Apache Spark.

classes.name: WritablePartitionedIterator
classes.description: Iterator class that writes elements to a writer instead of returning them, with support for partitioned data.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Insert a key-value pair with a partition into the collection.

methods.name: partitionedDestructiveSortedIterator
methods.description: Iterate through data in order of partition ID and optional key comparator, potentially destroying the collection.

methods.name: destructiveSortedWritablePartitionedIterator
methods.description: Create a writable iterator over the collection in sorted order, potentially destroying the collection.

methods.name: partitionComparator
methods.description: Comparator for (Int, K) pairs ordered by partition ID only.

methods.name: partitionKeyComparator
methods.description: Comparator for (Int, K) pairs ordered by partition ID and key comparator.
